item.title: Omega Oil & Gas Secures H&P; Rig for Expanded Taroom Trough Drill Program
item.description: Omega Oil & Gas (ASX:OMA) lands premium Helmerich & Payne FlexRig 648 for a fully funded Taroom Trough drill campaign in 2026/27, with mid-2026 results.

item.title: Victory Metals Achieves 5.9% TREO Concentrate in Major Flotation Upgrade
item.description: Victory Metals (ASX: VTM) hits 5.9% TREO concentrate in 48x flotation upgrade at North Stanmore, hinting at lower CAPEX/OPEX ahead of Q2 2026 PFS.

item.title: FBR Boosts Hadrian Homes Scaling Strategy with AMOVEO WaaS Offtake Agreement
item.description: FBR inks binding AMOVEO offtake for Hadrian Homes: 5400m2 wall over 24 months, AUD 400k–450k; aims to deliver ~200 homes in 12 months.

item.title: Ausgold Chases Resource Growth at Katanning Gold Project with Expanded Drilling Campaign
item.description: Ausgold (ASX: AUC) expands Katanning drill program to 54,000m after strong Central/Southern zone assays, hinting at resource growth and future reserve upside.

item.title: Terragen's GLP Biostimulant Trials Show 12% Maize Silage Yield Increase
item.description: Terragen's GLP biostimulant delivers 12% maize silage yield increase (8.81 t/ha) and up to 20x ROI, boosting near-term commercialisation plans.

item.title: Conrad Asia Energy Gets Green Light for Development of Mako Gas Project
item.description: Conrad Asia Energy secures FID for US$320m Mako gas project in Indonesia; first gas targeted by end-2027, fully funded with long-term PLN contract.

item.title: St George Mining Increases Araxá Mineral Resource Estimate to 70.91Mt TREO
item.description: St George Mining (ASX: SGQ) lifts Araxá MRE to 70.91Mt at 4.06% TREO and 0.62% Nb; 75% upgrade with 218% more M&I, underpinning Tier 1 potential.

item.title: Bio-Gene Technology Targets March 2027 APVMA Submission for Flavocide as Toxicology Studies Continue
item.description: Bio-Gene targets APVMA submission for Flavocide in March 2027 as toxicology studies progress, but faces ongoing cash burn and fundraising risk.

item.title: Which Stocks Benefit from a Uranium Supply Deficit?
item.description: Uranium supply deficit could lift shares as Australia leverages domestic reserves and SMRs to secure base-load power.

item.title: OMG Group to Expand PrOATein Ready-to-Drink Range in Woolworths Supermarkets
item.description: OMG Group to roll out three new PrOATein RTDs in 943 Woolworths stores from May to June, backed by SANDAI matcha supply, boosting growth prospects.
